text_block_list.text:
Summer camp came to an end, and as we 
prepared to head back to Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. I'm sure I've gotten a lot 
stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —...No rush, one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —It seems everyone had a wonderful summer.

During this summer training camp, Sounds 
of Earth was able to develop her running 
even further...!

I'm genuinely looking forward to seeing 
what height she will reach by the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Now, all that's left is to look forward 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
For the moment when their strides overlap 
with our own, that is.

The season is about to turn, and so it 
begins. Together with autumn, a melody 
unknown to all—
